title: Spent the last day building this fun Call of Duty clone on Spawn.co and I'm truly blown away by how easy it was, and how playable it is! It's very silly but it's addicting!
author: 2777what
selftext:
I have no programming experience whatsoever but have messed around with shitposting using AI (videos on Sora, music with Suno, etc.)

I heard about Spawn for making games a while ago and figured I'd give it a shot and I'm truly amazed at how fun it is. I spent the last day making this Call of Duty shipment clone/parody and had a blast getting everything looking right, and getting to be creative with the writing/bits. 

I legitimately just in like, plain english with no prompt engineering or anything fancy, just barked orders at this ai and it made a full-on replica of Shipment with cool visuals, and it brought all of my stupid ideas to life. For example the 25 kill streak is Jesus getting mad at you for fighting on his birthday, and there is a weird dark humor to it. 

It's like an imagination machine!
